text:
[Council File 26-0335; CD 6]
Motion (Padilla – Lee) relative to designating the intersection of Terra Bella Street and Woodman Avenue as “Veterans Memorial Square." The subtext of the sign should read “In Memory of Sgt. Adrian Carrillo, USMC.”
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Aug 28, 2026); Council action final
